title: Simplify failure artifact cleanup UI
summary: Simplified the Reports failure artifact cleanup panel by removing the visible reason field, typed confirmation phrase, and cleanup browser modal while keeping the backend-owned dry-run fingerprint and confirm_delete route contract. Also classified existing Launch CSV inspect/open controls in the WebView command-boundary audit.
reason: The cleanup panel had too many frontend-only hurdles after the backend already enforced the meaningful mutation guard: a preview fingerprint, boolean confirm_delete, backend allowlisted artifact roots, and a delete manifest.
behavior_before: Failure artifact cleanup required previewing, entering a reason, typing DELETE FAILURE ARTIFACTS, and accepting a browser modal before the frontend sent confirm_delete.
behavior_after: Failure artifact cleanup is preview then delete. The frontend sends a default audit reason plus the matching dry-run fingerprint and confirm_delete: true; the backend still owns deletion scope and rejects missing or stale fingerprints.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_reports_view_static.py coverage for the simplified failure artifact cleanup UI and command-boundary classification.
rollback_plan: Revert the Reports cleanup UI/JS/test/inventory changes, rerun the WebView generators, refresh generated summaries, and rerun the same Reports static and WebView checks.
